title: salvia lutescens var. intermedia
intro: Salvia lutescens var. intermedia, commonly known as Gold Leaf Sage, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation, promoting relaxation, and relieving stress. The health benefits of Salvia lutescens var. intermedia include its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as sedation and analgesia.
